constraints.description: The OS-assigned primary listener remains owned continuously from port allocation through Axum serving.
READY is emitted exactly once only after fallible application initialization succeeds; startup failure emits no READY record.

validation.validation_method: startup-failure test and protocol adversarial review

constraints.description: BossFang consumes an executable uar-sidecar from a GHCR tag equal to the merged UAR commit SHA.

validation.validation_method: GHCR workflow, manifest inspection, and container executable probe

constraints.description: The exact image pin passes BossFang sidecar unit/integration tests, workspace library check, formatting, branding, and diff integrity.

global_rules: Keep UAR as a process/HTTP boundary; do not collapse it into the BossFang address space.
Do not pin an unpublished or mutable image tag.
Do not broaden the patch to unrelated UAR clippy debt.
termination_conditions: The merged UAR SHA is published, probed, pinned, and certified downstream.
